Two PCB designs are provided: `/home/user/Desktop/A.kicad_pcb` and `/home/user/Desktop/B.kicad_pcb`. Use KiCad 10.0.2; run `kicad` for the GUI or `kicad-cli` for scripting/headless use (use PATH or the full install path). For this workflow, the installed KiCad tools are `/usr/bin/kicad-cli`, `/usr/bin/pcbnew`, and `/usr/bin/eeschema`; use the one that matches the board or schematic operation.

The mixed-panel build ticket is `/home/user/Desktop/order.txt`; use it for slot origins, copy labels, refdes suffixing, rail dimensions, V-score guides, fiducials, and tooling holes.

Create `/home/user/Desktop/panel.kicad_pcb` as a KiCad PCB panel that satisfies that build ticket. Replicate the source board geometry and footprints into the requested slots without changing the source boards. Preserve the A-board UA* references and B-board UB* references, applying only the copy suffixes specified in the ticket. Add the panel frame and manufacturing features described in the ticket, and keep the finished panel inside the ticketed outer dimensions.
